items.title: 23.3.2 Tests of Aldehydes and Ketones (aldehydes aur ketones ki pehchan ke tests) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 23.3.2 with Quick Check 23.2 (answers need review), printed pages 103-104 (PDF 106-107).

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones oxidise ho kar carboxylic acids bante hain. Aldehydes aasani se oxidise ho jate hain, jab ke ketones oxidation se reluctant (katrate) hain, kyun ke un ki oxidation mein C–C bond torna parta hai. Is liye ketones sirf strong (taqatwar) oxidizing agents se oxidise hote hain, jab ke aldehydes weak (kamzor) aur strong dono se. Isi farq par neeche ke tests bane hain.

Tollen's reagent ko ammoniacal silver nitrate solution bhi kehte hain. Is mein aqueous alkaline solution ke andar silver ions hote hain. Aldehyde ke saath halka garam karne par yeh silver ions reduce ho kar silver metal ban jate hain aur test tube ki deewar par silver mirror (chandi ka aaina) ban jata hai. Glucose (aldehyde wali shakar) ka dilute solution isi reaction se ghar ke (domestic) aaine banane mein istemal hota tha. Ketones yeh test nahi dete.

blocks.alt: Round-bottom (gol pende wala) flask jis ki andar ki deewar par chamakdar silver mirror jam gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 23.3: Sirf aldehydes Tollens' test positive dete hain (kitab ki Figure 23.3 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flask ki andar ki deewar par silver ki chamakdar layer (parat) jam gai hai. Yeh aldehyde ki pehchan hai; ketone se aisa mirror nahi banta.

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Yeh equation Tollen's reagent banane ki hai: silver nitrate aur ammonium hydroxide se [Ag(NH₃)₂]OH banta hai. Aldehyde is ke Ag⁺ ko Ag metal (aaina) mein reduce karta hai aur khud acid (alkaline solution mein us ka salt) ban jata hai.

Fehling's solution Cu²⁺ ions ka chamakdar neela solution hai jo alkaline (aqueous) medium mein tartaric acid ke salt ke saath complex bana kar rakha jata hai. Aldehyde ke saath garam karne par Cu²⁺ ions reduce ho kar Cu⁺ ions ban jate hain, jo alkaline solution mein copper(I) oxide, Cu₂O, ka brick-red (eent jaisa laal) precipitate (neeche baithne wala solid) banate hain. Ketones yeh test nahi dete.

blocks.alt: Do test tubes: baen wali mein chamakdar neela Fehling's solution; arrow ('aldehyde, warm') ke baad daen wali ke pende (bottom) mein brick-red Cu2O precipitate.
blocks.caption: Fehling's test: aldehyde ke saath garam karne par neela solution brick-red (eent jaisa laal) Cu₂O deta hai (hamari apni drawing; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Aldehydes aur ketones alpha (α) position par halogens se aasani se substitution reactions karte hain. Aldehydes mein sirf ethanal aur ketones mein sirf methyl ketones mein CH₃CO– group hota hai, jise acetyl (ethanoyl) group kehte hain. Yeh compounds sodium hydroxide ki presence (maujoodgi) mein iodine se react kar ke triiodomethane banate hain, jo aik peela crystalline solid hai aur iodoform kehlata hai. Is liye peela precipitate aana batata hai ke unknown (na-maloom) carbonyl compound mein CH₃CO– group hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab acetone wali equation mein bhi HCOO⁻Na⁺ (sodium methanoate) likhti hai. Propanone, CH₃COCH₃, se banne wala salt sodium ethanoate, CH₃COO⁻Na⁺, hai; sodium methanoate sirf ethanal se banta hai.

blocks.alt: Halke peele liquid wala round-bottom flask, jis ke pende (bottom) mein peela iodoform baith gaya hai.
blocks.caption: CH₃CO group wale aldehydes aur ketones, aur CH₃–CH(OH) group wale alcohols, iodoform test dete hain; is reaction mein peela iodoform banta hai (kitab ke page 107 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flask ke neeche baitha hua peela solid iodoform (CHI₃) hai. Peela precipitate batata hai ke compound mein CH₃CO– group (ya alcohol mein CH₃CH(OH)– group) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke box mein 'iodoform id formed' chhapa hai; sahi 'iodoform is formed' (iodoform banta hai) hai.

Ethanol bhi yeh test deta hai, jab ke methanol nahi deta. Wajah yeh hai ke ethanol mein CH₃–CH(OH)– hissa hai: iodine pehle ethanol ko ethanal, CH₃CHO, mein oxidise karti hai, jis mein methyl ketone jaisa CH₃–C=O hissa hai. Is liye ethanol se bhi iodoform banta hai aur test positive aata hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Compound A (C₃H₆O) NaBH₄ se compound B (C₃H₈O) deta hai. A aur B dono I₂/NaOH ke saath peela precipitate dete hain. A aur B pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: A propanone, CH₃COCH₃ (methyl ketone), hai; B propan-2-ol, CH₃CH(OH)CH₃, hai jis mein CH₃CH(OH)– group hai. Dono iodoform test dete hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Methanol iodoform test kyun nahi deta jab ke ethanol deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Methanol oxidise ho kar methanal banata hai jis mein CH₃CO– group nahi. Ethanol oxidise ho kar ethanal, CH₃CHO, banata hai jis mein yeh group hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Har jore ko pehchanne ka alag (different) test batayein: (i) CH₃CH₂CHO aur CH₃COCH₃; (ii) CH₃CH₂COCH₂CH₃ aur CH₃CH₂CH₂COCH₃; (iii) CH₂=CH–CH₂–OH aur CH₃CH₂CHO.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Tollen's (ya Fehling's) test: propanal silver mirror deta hai, propanone nahi.
(ii) Iodoform test: pentan-2-one (methyl ketone) peela precipitate deta hai, pentan-3-one nahi.
(iii) 2,4-DNPH test: propanal orange precipitate deta hai, prop-2-en-1-ol (alcohol) nahi.

items: Aldehydes aasani se oxidise hote hain; ketones sirf strong oxidizing agents se.
Tollen's: silver mirror; Fehling's: brick-red Cu₂O (sirf aldehydes).
Iodoform (I₂/NaOH): CH₃CO– ya CH₃CH(OH)– group ho to peela CHI₃.
